title: Ontology Atlas runs in the installed app
body: This address opens a screen of the app. Ontology Atlas reads and edits your Markdown folder only in the app installed on your computer.
otherComputers: The app runs on Apple Silicon Macs and, as a beta, on Windows x64. On an Intel Mac, Linux or a phone, <sample>see a sample map</sample>, or <guide>run the MCP server from the source code</guide> to connect a coding agent.
